selection_rule: Inventory precedes Step 7. Native frontend or architecture mismatch is unsupported/not applicable, artifact or build failure is unavailable/unresolved, and neither is an algorithmic miss.

comparators.name: Noir compiler/default checks
comparators.native_scope: Compile/check the pinned Noir producer packages and emit compiler diagnostics; no consumer-effect or user-policy interface.

applicability.GA-PAYY-TAIL: native producer/default arm at the revision-compatible pin
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-MSRC: native producer/default arm, but producer bytes are unchanged by the consumer-only mutation
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-RELATIONSHIP: native only for producer-side mutants; not applicable to consumer-only rows

historical_native_evidence.role: Pinned commands, default/lookback outputs, and bounded interpretation.
Extended exposed-mutant native results and effort.

comparators.claim_limit: A compiler warning is an E1 producer-side lint at most and does not supply a proof-to-execution authorization diagnosis.

comparators.name: Slither
comparators.native_scope: Generic/default Solidity and EVM-consumer detectors over pinned archived compiler inputs.

applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-MDOM: native generic/default consumer arm; consumer is byte-identical to the control
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-RELATIONSHIP: native for consumer-source rows; unsupported for producer-only rows

comparators.same_policy_adapter_boundary: A custom detector is an adapted arm, not a default Slither result. No frozen custom detector exists; its property lines and construction effort must be charged if Step 7 includes it.
comparators.claim_limit: Historical naming/reentrancy lints are E1 consumer-side signals only; they do not relate a producer word to an admitted state or protected effect.

comparators.name: Mythril
comparators.native_scope: Generic/default symbolic execution of archived EVM runtime bytecode.

applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-MDOM: native consumer-bytecode arm; bytecode is identical to the control
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-RELATIONSHIP: native for consumer bytecode; producer-only mutations are unsupported unless they change supplied bytecode

comparators.same_policy_adapter_boundary: A Solidity assertion wrapper is possible but is an adapted property arm. None was frozen or built for these cases.

historical_native_evidence.role: Sequential fairness retries and unresolved disposition.

comparators.claim_limit: Timeouts, crashes, partial generic reports, and an absent assertion wrapper remain unresolved and are not misses.

comparators.name: Foundry invariant testing
comparators.native_scope: Stateful invariant testing of the actual pinned or mutated Solidity consumer through a handwritten direct property harness.

applicability.GA-PAYY-TAIL: applicable only if a revision-specific policy wrapper is constructed; historical check-added control alone is insufficient
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-MDOM: consumer same-policy arm runs, but the current policy does not encode producer application-domain binding
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-RELATIONSHIP: native for expressible consumer state/effect properties; unsupported for purely producer relations unless a charged producer adapter is supplied

comparators.adaptation: The property itself is handwritten and must be counted; Foundry is native to the Solidity harness, not a native proof-to-execution analyzer.
comparators.claim_limit: The relational verifier stub checks exact words but is not a real proof/verifier execution. A passing campaign is not safety evidence, and human policy review is unresolved.

comparators.name: Echidna
comparators.native_scope: Property fuzzing over Solidity contracts; there is no meaningful property-free default detector arm.

applicability.GA-PAYY-TAIL: same-policy only after a compatible wrapper replaces unsupported cheatcodes
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-MDOM: same-policy in principle, but historical ports stopped before fuzzing
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-MSRC: same-policy in principle, but historical ports stopped before fuzzing
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-RELATIONSHIP: only for properties expressible in a compatible Solidity harness

historical_native_evidence.role: Nine retained setup attempts; all stopped on unlinked libraries before fuzzing.

comparators.claim_limit: Setup failures before fuzzing are unresolved construction cells, not misses.

comparators.name: ZKAP
comparators.native_scope: Circom Circuit Dependence Graph and query-based vulnerability patterns, including unused public inputs.

applicability.GA-PAYY-TAIL: native input unsupported because the exposed producer is Noir; a Circom translation would be a charged adaptation
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-MDOM: native input unsupported because the exposed producer is Noir; a Circom translation would be a charged adaptation
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-MSRC: consumer-only mutation is outside the native circuit scope
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-RELATIONSHIP: possible only for producer-side rows after an independently validated Circom adaptation

comparators.claim_limit: No ZKAP target run exists. Language mismatch cannot be scored as a ZKAP failure, and unused-public-input detection is established prior work.

comparators.name: CIVER
comparators.native_scope: Circom modular verification with weak-safety/determinism, tags, preconditions, postconditions, and spec facts.

applicability.GA-PAYY-TAIL: native Noir/ACIR input unsupported by the inspected artifact; a Circom/spec translation would be charged
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-MDOM: native Noir/ACIR input unsupported; rich same-policy specification is possible only after adaptation
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-MSRC: consumer-only mutation is outside native circuit scope
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-RELATIONSHIP: producer properties only after a validated translation; consumer relation requires an additional adapted join

comparators.claim_limit: CIVER's expressive specifications make manual information and property effort part of any future fair comparison; no result is claimed here.

comparators.name: CCC-Check
comparators.native_scope: CirC IR value inference over prover computation and verifier constraints; the paper reports Noir, Circom, and ZoKrates frontends.

applicability.GA-PAYY-TAIL: potential producer comparator, but exact pinned Noir compatibility and build remain unresolved
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-MDOM: potential producer comparator, but exact pinned Noir compatibility and build remain unresolved
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-MSRC: consumer-only mutation lies outside its documented computation/constraint relation
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-RELATIONSHIP: potential for producer rows; consumer relationship requires a separately charged adapter

comparators.claim_limit: The bounded local build failure and absence of an admitted exact-version adapter are construction limitations, not evidence about CCC-Check's analysis.

comparators.name: Picus
comparators.native_scope: Circom, iden3 R1CS, and gnark SR1CS constraint checking in the pinned artifact; not Noir ACIR.

applicability.GA-PAYY-TAIL: native input unsupported; an ACIR-to-supported-R1CS adapter would require independent semantic validation
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-MSRC: consumer-only mutation is outside native circuit scope
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-RELATIONSHIP: possible only for producer rows after a charged validated input adaptation

comparators.claim_limit: The successful bundled self-check establishes tool availability only; it is not a target analysis.

comparators.name: SmartAxe
comparators.native_scope: Paired source/destination bridge-contract EVM bytecode with cross-chain data/control-flow alignment.

applicability.GA-PAYY-TAIL: architecture not applicable: not a paired deposit/withdraw bridge fixture
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-MDOM: native bridge-pair applicability unresolved and downloadable artifact unavailable
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-MSRC: native bridge-pair applicability unresolved and downloadable artifact unavailable
applicability.GA-WARPTOAD-RELATIONSHIP: requires a true paired bridge case; a same-chain consumer row is not a native SmartAxe miss

comparators.claim_limit: The historical WAF-blocked artifact and uncertain bridge pairing are unresolved availability/applicability, not a tool result.

comparators.name: ELSA
comparators.native_scope: The official abstract reports an LLM-assisted analyzer ensemble and evaluation on self-constructed ZKP-based smart contracts; exact circuit inputs and protocol are unresolved.

applicability.GA-PAYY-TAIL: unresolved until full paper, artifact, models, prompts, labels, and inputs are available

comparators.selection_reason: Step 6b does not select or fabricate an LLM baseline. A future optional arm requires a pinned artifact, model, prompt, context, stochastic settings, cost cap, and scoring protocol before any run.
comparators.claim_limit: The accessible abstract is insufficient to assert either overlap or non-overlap with circuit-to-consumer reasoning.

equal_treatment_requirements.information_parity: Every included same-policy comparator receives the exact same frozen artifacts, admitted state, policy fields, bounds, and honest seeds that its interface can consume; unavailable interface fields remain explicit rather than synthesized.
equal_treatment_requirements.normalization: Retain native output and missing fields. Never infer a producer relation, consumer effect, source location, or two-sided explanation absent from native output.
equal_treatment_requirements.validation: Every unique comparator candidate follows the Step 5 draft common E2-E4 route and budgets; this inventory authorizes no validation run.
equal_treatment_requirements.effort: Count source adaptation, property/specification lines, annotations, setup, corrections, proof seeds, runtime, human review, and adjudication separately.
equal_treatment_requirements.outcomes: Step 7 alone may freeze eligible/unsupported/not-applicable/build-failed/unresolved classifications and score completed arms.

historical_bundle.reuse_rule: Historical outputs retain their original versions, exposure, evidence grades, limits, and unresolved/unsupported dispositions; they are citations, not fresh Step 6b results.

step_7_open_items: Freeze exact applicability per finalized case byte set before output.
Decide prospectively whether any charged ZKAP, CIVER, CCC-Check, Picus, Slither, Mythril, or Echidna adaptation is feasible and necessary; an absent adapter is not a miss.
Resolve or exclude SmartAxe using a genuine paired bridge case and an available pinned artifact.
Keep ELSA out unless its full reproducible protocol is obtained and frozen; the core comparison must not wait for it.
Record human policy author/adopter, distinct reviewer, and any overlap/exposure before the Foundry same-policy arm can enter a sealed score packet.
